summary: Built and verified a TLS-secured Vault Transit provider on node1 and a three-voter integrated Raft cluster on node2–node4. Raft members automatically unseal through Transit, KV v2 contains the requested proof, administrative environment files are protected, one-member availability was demonstrated, and all four nodes passed sequential restart persistence testing.
actions_performed: Installed Vault 2.1.1 and configured validated TLS on all nodes.
Created the node1 Transit provider with a restricted auto-unseal key and policy.
Configured node2–node4 as integrated Raft voters using Transit auto-unseal.
Enabled KV v2 at secret/ and stored proof=raft-auto-unseal at secret/infraset.
Created root-owned mode-0600 /root/vault-admin.env files on every Raft member.
Demonstrated availability with node4 stopped and verified its voter recovery.
Restarted every managed node individually and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.summary: Each certificate verified against the common trust bundle and contains the correct node DNS and IP SANs.

evidence.requirement: Functional Transit seal provider on node1
evidence.summary: Transit and the autounseal key are enabled; final validated-TLS encryption/decryption round-trip succeeded.
node2–node4 report Transit seal, integrated Raft storage, sealed=false, and membership as three voters.

evidence.requirement: KV v2 proof and administrative access files
evidence.summary: KV v2 is mounted at secret/, proof=raft-auto-unseal is readable on every member, and all administrative environment files are root-owned mode 0600.

evidence.requirement: Availability with one Raft member down and voter recovery
evidence.summary: The cluster served health and proof data while node4 was stopped; node4 then auto-unsealed, caught up, and returned as a voter.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart and Transit recovery
evidence.summary: Captured healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered unsealed Transit provider.

evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart and Raft recovery
evidence.summary: Boot identity changed; node2 auto-unsealed, retained data, and rejoined the voter set after leadership failed over.

evidence.requirement: node3 mandatory restart and Raft recovery
evidence.summary: Boot identity changed; node3 auto-unsealed, retained data, and rejoined the voter set after leadership failed over.

evidence.requirement: node4 mandatory restart and Raft recovery
evidence.summary: Boot identity changed; node4 auto-unsealed, retained data, and rejoined the voter set with all three voters healthy.
